lesson.low: {{temp}}°C sits in the low zone — the flavor range. Gentle heat vaporizes the most delicate terpenes first, so the vapor tastes brighter and the effects tend to feel lighter and clearer. This is how connoisseurs taste a strain before they chase potency.
lesson.medium: {{temp}}°C sits in the middle zone — the balance point. Warm enough to extract the heavier compounds, cool enough to keep most of the terpene character intact. Flavor and strength meet here, which is why most everyday sessions live in this range.
lesson.high: {{temp}}°C sits in the high zone — maximum extraction. The vapor comes out thicker and the body effects land harder, traded against some of the finer flavor notes. Experienced users finish a bowl here once the tasting is done.
